function.arguments: {"finding": "The contract specifies that the population is 'all customers in the sales data (all rows, no filtering)', but -1 values in 'customer_age' are not valid ages. Computing the mean over all rows would include invalid data (-1), which would distort the result. The question asks for the mean age, but age cannot be meaningfully defined for customers with sentinel -1 values — they did not provide their age. Thus, including them would produce a nonsensical mean.", "implication": "The estimand 'mean age' must be interpreted as the mean age of customers who provided their age. The population 'all customers' cannot be used directly because one of its defining variables is invalid for 12% of the rows. The only valid way to compute the mean age is over the subset where age is valid. This is standard practice in data analysis: invalid or missing values are excluded from the mean of a variable they represent. To include -1 would be to treat a missing-data placeholder as a real age, which would be incorrect."}
function.name: note_finding
